pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. OBJECTS, a compact arrangement of four everyday items on white: a blue mug, a plain yellow pencil, a red ball and closed green scissors. Each simple recognizable object is separate, complete and easily seen. Uniform solid colors and clear dark outlines. No human, no writing or markings. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
